title:
—Heavenly God! cried Stephen’s soul, in an outburst of profane joy
 
 He turned away from her suddenly and set off across the strand. His cheeks were aflame; his body was aglow; his limbs were trembling.
html_source: Each chapter, Stephen experiences a building of impulses which outburst suddenly at the end. Here, Stephen changes his course of action as his understanding of the world and clarity in his purpose overwhelms him. These periodic rises further relate him to the story of Icarus. He is developing as an artist.
